title: Philippine hawk-eagle turned over in Sanchez Mira, Cagayan

blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY — A village watchman had rescued and then turned over a juvenile northern Philippine hawk-eagle to the Sanchez Mira town’s Tourism and Information Office in Cagayan, the municipal government reported on Wednesday (Oct. 14). Village watchman and farmer Melvin Camua of Callungan village caught the starving bird, which had been eating chicks inside his yard. The Northern Philippine Hawk Eagle is an avifauna-listed endangered species at the IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature) Red List worldwide, “making the decision of Camua the proper call,” the Sanchez Mira information and tourism office said.
